# tools/rgcpu calls them as runtime boundaries: a hook may read any argument
# register. Collected with tools/rgcpu/hooks.sh (RG_NATIVE_CPU_HOOKS=FILE at boot, in
# several setups; src/native_cpu.cpp also warns at boot about a hooked slot missing here).
